dataset: CDC BRFSS 2025 (356,158 US adults, 6,000-row seeded stratified cap) - label CVDSTRK3 = ever told stroke (4.6% of the source). 7 of the 16 app columns are real; family history, BP and the TIA/speech/palpitations symptoms are not surveyed (NaN) - deliberately: the previous Kaggle mapping stored the respondent's OWN hypertension/heart_disease in the family_* columns while the app asks the user for FAMILY history, so the model learned a personal-history effect and applied it to a family flag. Legacy fallback: Kaggle fedesoriano (5,110 rows).
known_limitations: App-aligned projection of a real public dataset (ml/data/README.md) — not a local clinical sample; revalidate on local data before clinical use

Columns the source dataset never collected: family_diabetes, family_heart, family_hypertension, family_cancer, bp_systolic, bp_diastolic, tia_symptoms, speech_difficulty, irregular_heartbeat — the app still asks these but the model cannot use them (LOW_FEATURE_MODEL)
Screening and awareness tool only, not a diagnostic device
